newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to discuss $500 mln soft loan from UAE.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to discuss $500 mln soft loan from UAE.

text.p: Pakistani finance ministry officials will go to the United Arab Emirates (UAE) on Wednesday to seek financial help and promote a privatisation programme, a government official said.

He said the team, led by Shahid Javed Burki, Finance and Economic Affairs adviser to caretaker Prime Minister Meraj Khalid, would discuss a soft loan of up to $500 million promised by the UAE last month.
Burki will discuss with UAE officials the terms and exact amount of the loan, as well as investment opportunities offered by Pakistan's privatisation programme, the official said.
